_note: D64 (2026-10-26). The buttons of cookie banners and consent walls that the browser agent knows. 'reject' is clicked by itself (it grants nothing); 'accept' is clicked ONLY on a site where the owner gave the one-time accept_terms grant (the kernel treats an accept click as accepting terms: class C). Names are matched whole and case-insensitively. Protected from agent pushes (push_gate). Labels added 2026-10-26 from the reject buttons that are text in the pinned DuckDuckGo Autoconsent v16.61.0 rule set (MPL-2.0; npm tarball sha1 5bdbb7db784be8a0628c16d6db038a2346227279, the registry's own checksum) and common CMP wording; the library itself is not run (see D64: it needs script injection, which the node never allows). A label that begins with Accept or Allow is never in 'reject': the kernel treats it as accepting terms.
